To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

higher levels of education of parents, female education ratio in village, income of the household, long distances of schools, child labour, low social status of families and harmony in the marital relation have positive or negative effect on females' educational attainment.

the low educational attainment of females in rural Pakistan is mainly due to the low educational levels of parents, long distances of schools, low status of the family in the community and the low income of the family, while female education ratio and harmony in marital relations have positive effect on the education levels of female children in the rural areas of Pakistan.
The major causes for the low educational attainment of rural females in Pakistan are long distances of schools, low status of family, female child labour and lack of harmony in marital relationship".
In summary, our research is concerned with
the causes of low level of education of rural females in Pakistan.
the causes of low female education in Pakistan.
the causes and remedies of low levels of female education, which is an important factor for the overall development of society in terms of socio-economic, political and cultural development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the low educational attainment of females is due to a number of factors, which can be controlled by the government, the community and the parents.
the education of females is a very crucial issue in Pakistan, and the policy-makers and other stakeholders should take it as an urgent issue.

the education of females in rural areas of Pakistan can be improved through a number of strategies, including the establishment of more schools in rural areas, controlling child-labor and educating the females of low social status cast.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the low educational attainment of rural females in Pakistan is a result of the low status of females, their parents and their families in the rural society.

the educational attainment of women is a key determinant of the health status and economic growth of the nation and it can be improved by focussing on education of girls at the primary and secondary level.
, the educational level of females can be improved by focussing on those factors which are identified as the causes of low level of female educational attainment in Pakistan.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the government and non-government organizations should focus on the establishment of secondary-level schools for girls and should control child-labour.
the educational levels of women are not only a function of the educational level of their parents but also the social and cultural environment of the community.
the education of women is a key to the development of a society.
